correctness.rationale: For each 0<t<1, Gamma/Beta factorization of radial Fock monomials gives the exact binomial tail diagonal and Pascal weight w_(n,m)=(1-t)sqrt(n+1) Bin(n+m+1,n+1)t^(n+1)(1-t)^m. Reconstructed the large-deviation/Stirling argument: escaping limsup and arbitrarily long consecutive near-peak weights both equal R=sqrt((1-t)/(2pi)). Fixed-m unilateral fibers are compact quasinilpotent; uniform Neumann resolvents outside |lambda|>R and unbounded inverse norms on increasingly long near-peak blocks inside 0<|lambda|<R show the direct sum is non-Fredholm on the full disk. At zero cokernel is infinite-dimensional; all point eigenvalues absent by forward-shift recursion. Independently checked 98 exact rational Pascal identities, peak convergence, and w_(1,0)(4/5)=16sqrt(2)/125>1/sqrt(10pi). Finite checks do not prove the infinite operator claims.
residual_risks: Stirling estimates require t fixed in the open interval; no t=0 or 1 assertion.
